title: Restaurant
subtitle: Kitchen orders, recipe cards, ingredient inventory and production.

lock.title: The Restaurant module is part of the Pro plan
lock.body: Track orders by status, recipe cards with cost and margin, automatic ingredient deduction and shortage alerts.

comum.erroCarregar: Could not load the restaurant data. Reload the page.

pedidos.desc: When preparation starts, the recipe-card ingredients are deducted from inventory automatically.
pedidos.semPratos: Create and activate at least one dish (with a recipe card) to take orders.

cancelar.comBaixa: This order's ingredients have already left inventory. What should happen to them?
cancelar.estornoHint: The dish was not made: ingredients go back to the balance (reversal entry).
cancelar.perdaHint: The dish was already made and will be discarded: inventory stays deducted and the waste is recorded.
cancelar.semBaixa: Preparation has not started — inventory is not changed.

falta.desc: Some ingredients are short. Here is what is missing:
falta.forcarHint: The short ingredients go to a negative balance and the entry is recorded as forced, with your name and the reason.
falta.motivoPlaceholder: E.g.: goods arrived but were not recorded yet

ficha.perdaHint: Trim loss, as % of the gross weight (e.g. peel). The deduction uses the gross weight.
ficha.legenda: Net quantity in the base unit (g, ml, un) · waste in %

pratos.desc: Cost and margin come from the recipe card and the ingredients' average cost.
pratos.vazioDesc: Add the menu dishes with each one's recipe card.
pratos.rendimentoHint: How many servings the card makes. The cost is divided by this number.
pratos.fichaObrigatoria: To activate the dish, the recipe card needs at least one ingredient.

ingredientes.desc: Balance, minimum and average cost. The balance only changes through entries (purchase, deduction, adjustment, waste, production).
ingredientes.vazioDesc: Add raw ingredients and in-house preps (sauces, doughs…).
ingredientes.baseFixa: The base unit cannot change after creation.
ingredientes.baseHint: Balance and recipe cards use this unit.
ingredientes.exibHint: Minimum, cost and opening balance are typed in this unit.
ingredientes.custoHint: Editable; purchases recalculate the weighted average cost.
ingredientes.saldoInicialHint: Recorded as a purchase entry in the history.
ingredientes.preparoHint: E.g. a sauce made in the kitchen. It has its own recipe and yield and is produced in batches on the Production tab.
ingredientes.rendimentoHint: How much prep one full recipe makes.

mov.entradaHint: Adds to the balance and recalculates the weighted average cost with this purchase's cost.
mov.ajusteHint: Enter the counted balance; the difference becomes an adjustment entry.
mov.perdaHint: Waste, expiry, breakage: the quantity leaves the balance.
mov.custoTotalHint: Amount paid for the quantity entered.

historico.desc: Recent movements (immutable log — corrections are recorded as adjustments).

producao.agoraTitulo: What needs to be made now
producao.agoraDesc: Dishes from received and preparing orders. Ingredients: only orders that have not started (no deduction yet).
producao.vazio: No open orders in the kitchen.
producao.insumosVazio: Open orders have already been deducted.
producao.perdaDesc: Record what was discarded in the kitchen (leaves the balance, with a reason).
producao.loteDesc: Deducts the recipe ingredients in proportion to the amount made and adds it to the prep balance.
producao.semPreparosDesc: Mark an ingredient as an "in-house prep" and add its recipe to produce batches.
producao.semReceita: This prep has no recipe and yield yet.

alertas.vazioDesc: All ingredients are above the minimum and cover the open orders.
alertas.whatsappHint: When a deduction leaves an ingredient at the minimum or out of stock, the owner gets a WhatsApp alert (if the Inventory alert is on in Settings > WhatsApp). It is not repeated while the ingredient stays low.
